content: अमर {%a.%} [मृ-पचाद्यच्, <sab>न˚ त˚</sab>] Undying, immortal, imperishable; अजरामरवत् प्राज्ञो विद्यामर्थं च चिन्तयेत् <ls>H. Pr. 3</ls>; <ls>Ms. 2. 148</ls>. अजरोऽमरोऽमृतः <ls>Bṛ. Up. 4. 4. 25</ls>. .{@-रः@} .²1 A god, deity. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a Marut. .²3 <ab>N.</ab> of a plant Euphorbia Tirucalli (स्नुहीवृक्ष; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>शेर</ns>). Tiaridium Indicum (हस्तिशुण्ड ?; <lang>Mar.</lang> <ns>भुरुंडी</ns>). .²4 Quick-silver. .²5 Gold. .²6 A species of pine. .²7 The number 33. (that being the number of Gods.) .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of Amarasiṃha, see below; of a mountain. .²9 Mystical signification of the syllable उ. .²10 A heap of bones. .{@-रा@} .²1 The residence of Indra (<ab>cf.</ab> अमरावती). .²2 The naval string; umbilical cord. .²3 The womb. .²4 A house-post (स्थूणा). .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of several plants; इन्द्रवारुणी, वटी, महानीली, घृतकुमारी, स्नुही, गुडूची, दूर्वा. .{@-री@} The same as अमरा.
